title: MES-MII Outdoor
descriptions: A manufacturing execution system that guides and documents the transformation of raw materials into finished products on the Renson Outdoor production site. It replaced paper-driven production with paperless, built on SAP and Industry 4.0 standards, and now runs on around 200 workstations across 60 production lines.

I was the founding developer on the project and I contributed full-stack while specializing and owning the development and architecture of the front-end. The front-end is an Nx monorepo of 9 Angular applications, 100+ libraries and over 50,000 lines of code using TypeScript, Angular Material and Sass, built on a back-end with SAP MII, Veri95 and Sybase, with SAP NetWeaver and Kepware server technologies underneath.
The application works in real time and gives the plant floor control over inputs, personnel, machines and support services.

title: Warmste Hackathon
descriptions: A competition platform for teams developing an innovative idea around a socially relevant theme, built at Realdolmen with a small team.
I contributed full-stack in Angular, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate and PostgreSQL. I built modular, reusable Angular components and set up the project's linting.
The application tracks standings, handles communication within and between teams, and streamlines the flow of development tooling and coaching so organisers can step in wherever a team needs support.

title: MatchMan
descriptions: An internal staffing platform that matches consultants to customer projects on technical skills, following up customers, schedules and opportunities in one place.
I contributed full-stack in Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, TypeORM and MySQL. I refactored the customer-creation front-end and built the proposition page with full CRUD and validation.

Extensive search functionality accelerates the entire staffing and planning process, so resourcing decisions are driven by the technical skills a project actually needs rather than by who happens to be free.

title: ERP Demo
descriptions: My graduation project at b-inside: an ERP demo that monitors warehouse logistics, built in Angular with Ionic on a Progress OpenEdge back-end.
I did the full analysis and design and wrote both front- and back-end.
The application keeps an overview of orders, order lines, products, stock and employees, with full CRUD operations on every entity and a mobile-first interface for use on the warehouse floor.
